framingContract.leaseBytesAndSha: the final two bootstrap arguments bind exact raw stdin bytes and SHA-256

remotePlacementContract.atomicity: exclusive pending files are identity-captured, exact bytes/SHA verified, then atomically renamed; partial placement cleans only matching created identities and removes only an exact empty created parent

executionContract.manualRollbackCondition: only a Central-authorized terminal recovery after the primary failure or failed post-switch verification; never a deploy retry

exact bootstrap and executor blobs/bytes/SHA plus their base64 derivations
